SCIENCE ADVENTURE 13 · CLASS 31

Butterfly’s Life Cycle

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Life cycles

Egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly — number the four stages of a butterfly’s life.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · LIFE CYCLES

Butterfly’s Life Cycle

A butterfly grows in four steps! Tap the pictures in life order: first, next, then, and last.

Tap the butterfly’s life in order — first to last.

Metamorphosis complete!

Egg on a leaf, munching caterpillar, quiet chrysalis — then wings!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Metamorphosis is the most dramatic growth story in the garden — retell it with hand actions (egg, munch, sleep, FLUTTER) and then read The Very Hungry Caterpillar together.

Illustration note: The artwork deliberately shows the stages out of order: butterfly, eggs, caterpillar, chrysalis. The real order is eggs first, butterfly last.

Prefer paper? The Butterfly’s Life Cycle worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
